proposed_widenings.name: ActivationPhase.unconditional
proposed_widenings.justification: Greater Restoration applies its effects with no attack roll and no saving throw. All existing ActivationPhase variants (attack_roll, save_gate) require dice resolution. An unconditional phase kind is needed for spells that deliver effects directly on a successful touch with no further gate.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You touch a creature and magically remove one of the following effects from it

proposed_widenings.name: Effect.remove_condition
proposed_widenings.justification: The v4 taxonomy includes remove_condition as an effect atom, but it is absent from the Effect union in types.ts (which only has damage | none). Greater Restoration removes Charmed and Petrified conditions by name.

proposed_widenings.name: Effect.restore_max_hp
proposed_widenings.justification: Restoring a reduction to the target's Hit Point maximum maps to the v4 modify_max_hp effect atom, which is in the taxonomy but not in the surface Effect union.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Any reduction to the target's Hit Point maximum

proposed_widenings.name: Condition (type expansion)
proposed_widenings.justification: The current Condition type only contains 'prone'. Greater Restoration names charmed, petrified, and exhaustion (level-based). The closed Condition enum must be widened before remove_condition effects for this spell are representable.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The Charmed or Petrified condition; 1 Exhaustion level

proposed_widenings.name: remove_curse
proposed_widenings.justification: Curse removal (including breaking the target's Attunement to a cursed magic item) has no counterpart in the v4 effect atom inventory. remove_condition does not cover curses because curses are not conditions in the SRD 5.2.1 sense.
proposed_widenings.evidence: A curse, including the target's Attunement to a cursed magic item

proposed_widenings.name: restore_ability_score
proposed_widenings.justification: Reversing a reduction to one of the target's ability scores requires an atom for modifying ability score values at runtime. The v4 taxonomy defers modify_ability_score as out-of-scope (§12: 'modify_ability_score as a runtime effect — out-of-scope for the core mechanics graph'). This spell is direct pressure to promote or define a bounded form of that atom.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Any reduction to one of the target's ability scores

notes: Greater Restoration is a pure removal spell: instantaneous, no attack roll, no saving throw, unconditional touch delivery. None of the four existing SpellMechanics families encode 'unconditional effect application on touch' — the activation family's phases all require dice resolution. Even if an unconditional phase variant were added, the Effect union in types.ts has no removal variants; the needed atoms (remove_condition, modify_max_hp, remove_curse, restore_ability_score) are absent from the surface. The first four proposed widenings are surface gaps (v4 atoms exist but are not wired into Effect/ActivationPhase); the last two (remove_curse, restore_ability_score) are atom-level gaps. Primary classification is surface_widening because the structural family (activation) exists and a phase variant addition would resolve the delivery mechanism.
